DOSL7
       Namespace DOSL7

DESCRIPTION
       These commands and events are used to modify the ASM handling of layer 7 Denial of Service violations and events.

       Associated Events
	    * IN_DOSL7_ATTACK - Triggered when ASM detects that a request violates an ASM security policy for Denial of Service
       attacks

HINTS
SEE ALSO
BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
